svg.title: Complete Kuhn poker game tree
svg.desc: Six equiprobable ordered deals, 24 player decision nodes and 30 terminal histories. Matching purple tags identify the 12 two-node information sets: O for player 1 opening, R for player 1 after check-bet, C for player 2 after check, and B for player 2 after bet. The letter after the colon is the acting player's private card. Payoffs are net gains to players 1 and 2.
svg.text: Matching purple tags identify one information set; the card after the colon is the acting player’s own card.
O: opening (player 1) R: after check–bet (player 1) C: after check (player 2) B: after bet (player 2)
Deal: (player 1’s card, player 2’s card). Payoffs: (player 1’s net gain, player 2’s net gain).
